parameters.name: layout
parameters.label: Layout
parameters.description: For a smaller carousel, specify "mini". Leave blank for default. This is useful for compact designs, such as cart slideout menus.

parameters.name: titleLink
parameters.label: Title Link
parameters.description: Link for recommendations title. "Title" must be set.

parameters.name: description
parameters.label: Description
parameters.description: Descriptive text that will appear under the title.

parameters.name: perView
parameters.label: Slides Per View
parameters.description: Number of recommendations seen in desktop view.

parameters.name: perGroup
parameters.label: Slides Per Group
parameters.description: Number of recommendations to paginate by in desktop view.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.label: Number of Rows
parameters.description: Add a number to set recommendation results in a grid.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.label: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the amount of recommendations displayed. The maximum amount and default is 20.
